name: Julio Torres
bio: Julio Torres (born February 11, 1987) is a Salvadoran-American writer, comedian, and actor. He is best known as a writer for Saturday Night Live and as the co-creator, writer, and executive producer of the HBO series Los Espookys. He previously wrote for The Chris Gethard Show on truTV.

credits.title: La Bola Negra
credits.overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

credits.title: Lorne
credits.overview: An unprecedented, behind-the-scenes glimpse at the man who built the inimitable empire of comedy, shaping television and culture for generations. credits.title: Color Theories by Julio Torres. A Guide to Seeing the World
credits.overview: Julio Torres takes the stage in NYC and invites the audience to see the people, places, and things around us through his kaleidoscopic lens. Blending stand-up, an interactive set, and live drawings, Julio explores the inherent traits, personalities, and emotions of particular colors.

credits.title: Boys Go to Jupiter
credits.overview: A teenager in suburban Florida desperately hustles to make $5,000 in this dreamy and surreal animated coming-of-age story.

credits.title: Problemista
credits.overview: Alejandro is an aspiring toy designer from El Salvador, struggling to bring his unusual ideas to life in New York City. As time on his work visa runs out, a job assisting an erratic art-world outcast becomes his only hope to stay in the country and realize his dream.

credits.title: Millennial Hunter
credits.overview: An action-comedy that centers on a flawed hero with a thirst for righteous revenge against his enemies: Millennials.

credits.title: Nimona
credits.overview: A knight framed for a tragic crime teams with a scrappy, shape-shifting teen to prove his innocence.

credits.title: Together Together
credits.overview: When young loner Anna is hired as the surrogate for Matt, a single man in his 40s, the two strangers come to realize this unexpected relationship will quickly challenge their perceptions of connection, boundaries and the particulars of love.

credits.title: On Labor and Management
credits.overview: “When you see a hog, you see a garbage disposal; when you see a little bird, you see … whatever he wants to be.” A comedian gives voice to the hog who eats trash for the Flintstones: he petitions the boss for a promotion, only to realize that a dead-end job is his destiny.

credits.overview: In this multimedia comedy show, Torres explores his favorite shapes, which include a plexiglass square, a triangle, an oval that wishes he were a circle, a self-conscious cactus and a Ferrero Rocher chocolate that Julio is mad at because she left her little skirt at home. Brigsby Bear
credits.overview: Brigsby Bear Adventures is a children's TV show produced for an audience of one: James. When the show abruptly ends, James's life changes forever, and he sets out to finish the story himself.

credits.title: Snowy Bing Bongs Across the North Star Combat Zone
credits.overview: Dance-comedy trio Cocoon Central Dance lounges about, passes gas, and bursts into bizarre dance routines while navigating outer space interludes, doctor boners, and a '90s-style girl group meltdown.
